items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 61:1
items.html: The discernment of the coupling made in the world of Nekudim is called the light of the eyes, which is the discernment of the coarseness of phase one and phase two of clothing. And the discernment of the coupling made in the world of correction is phase one of clothing and the coarseness of the discernment of the root, called the forehead. As written above in Part 8. (Item 17).
